name: manual_ca873b
claim: When merging branches that both append to .agent memory (lessons.jsonl, episodic/AGENT_LEARNINGS.jsonl), resolve conflicts by UNION — keep both sides, dedup by lesson 'id' (jsonl) or by line (episodic) — then RE-RENDER LESSONS.md from lessons.jsonl via render_lessons.py (never hand-merge the rendered file, AGENTS.md Rule 5). Sanitize any leaked /Users/<name>/ paths to <user> placeholders first, or pre-commit repo_hygiene (LINT-006) blocks the merge commit. Use a throwaway git worktree to resolve without disturbing main's working tree.

decisions.notes: 2026-06-22: merged origin/main into feat/perpetua-submodule-upgrade for PR #123; 3 .agent files conflicted (both sides appended lessons); union+re-render gave 61 lessons/32 episodic; commit was blocked by workstation path leaks in branch dream-cycle content until sanitized.
